steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Change the event type from the default to RFQ.
Provide the mandatory event title required for publishing.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the pricing sheet can be populated.
Add one matching product and enter the requested quantity of 10.
Complete the pricing sheet after adding the line item.
Verify that the RFQ quantity cell retains 10.
Enter a price so the sheet can calculate a total amount.
Verify that Total Amount is populated once a price exists.
Invite one available QA test vendor so the event can be published.
Verify that publication reached a real project page.
